title: The Swindlers Swamp and the Fog — Part 1

series.summary: Examiner Satotz leads the applicants to the entrance of the foggy Numere Wetlands, warning them that deceitful monsters roam the marsh. The massive gates shut behind them, cutting off retreat as the runners plunge into the blinding mist.

segments.voiceover_text: Examiner Satotz halts the applicants before the mist-covered Numere Wetlands. He warns that bizarre predators roam here, mimicking humans to deceive and butcher their prey.
Suddenly, the massive exit gate crashes shut behind the runners, sealing off retreat. Thick fog pours in from all sides, completely swallowing the treacherous landscape.
Satotz breaks into an uncanny, rapid stride directly into the whiteout. His command is chilling: match his pace or get permanently abandoned.
Hundreds sprint blindly into the murk as visibility drops to nothing. But in the disorientation, Killua senses a far darker predator stalking them from the rear.
